questions.question: What is Lucent?
questions.answer: Lucent is a mindful Pomodoro app designed to help you focus, stay balanced, and build consistent productivity habits through structured work and break sessions.

questions.question: Can I use Lucent on multiple devices?
questions.answer: Yes! Your Lucent account syncs seamlessly across all your devices — keeping your focus sessions, statistics, and progress perfectly aligned.

questions.question: Does Lucent work offline?
questions.answer: Absolutely. You can start and complete your focus sessions even without an internet connection. Once you're back online, all your data will automatically sync.

questions.question: Can I customize my focus sessions?
questions.answer: Of course! You can adjust session duration, break times, and even create custom modes like Study, Work, or Meditation to fit your daily routine.

questions.question: Does Lucent integrate with Apple Health?
questions.answer: Yes. When enabled, your focus time will be logged as Mindful Minutes in Apple Health — helping you track your mental wellness alongside productivity.

questions.question: Is my data secure?
questions.answer: Absolutely. Your information is stored securely with end-to-end encryption. Lucent never shares or sells your personal data.

questions.question: What if I need help or have feedback?
questions.answer: Our support team is always here to help via in-app feedback or email. You can also explore our quick-start guide and community tips directly within the app.

meet-privacy.title: LucentMeet Privacy Policy
meet-privacy.intro: LucentMeet shows all your calendars in one timeline, warns you about conflicts and lets an AI assistant help you plan. This policy explains what data the LucentMeet app and website handle, why, and the choices you have. It applies only to LucentMeet; our Pomodoro app Lucent has its own policy.
highlights: We never sell your data and there are no ads or analytics SDKs in the app.
Sign-in only reads your basic profile. LucentMeet does not ask for access to your Google Calendar.
Calendars come from your phone (with your permission) or from iCal links you add, and are read-only unless you create or edit an event yourself.
The AI assistant proposes changes; nothing is written until you confirm.
You can delete your account and all synced data at any time from Settings.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: LucentMeet is published by the Lucent team. For anything in this policy, contact us at the address at the end of this page.

sections.title: Data we collect
paragraphs: We collect only what the app needs to work:
bullets: Account: your name, email address and profile picture, from Sign in with Google or Sign in with Apple (basic profile only).

Calendar data: calendar names and the events in them (title, description, location, start and end time, attendees, meeting link, availability). They come from the calendars on your device, if you allow calendar access, and from iCal feeds you add.
iCal feed links: the secret address you paste is stored encrypted and is never shown back to you or to anyone else.
Preferences: working days and hours, buffer between meetings, default reminder and time zone.
AI assistant: the messages you type and the calendar details needed to answer them.
Technical data: a sign-in session token. We do not collect advertising identifiers and we do not use analytics or tracking SDKs.

sections.title: What stays on your device
paragraphs: Your light/dark and language choice, the calendar view you picked, your focus-time window and the offline copy of your schedule are stored on your device. Reminders are scheduled locally on your phone; we do not send push marketing.

sections.title: How we use your data
bullets: To show your calendars in one timeline on the phone and on the web.
To detect overlaps, tight gaps and events outside your working hours, and to suggest better times.
To schedule reminders and show the home-screen widget.
To answer your questions in the AI assistant.
To keep the service secure, prevent abuse and fix problems.

sections.title: Calendar access and Google user data
paragraphs: Signing in with Google requests your basic profile only (name, email, picture). LucentMeet does not request the Google Calendar API scope when you sign in; on a phone it reads the calendars already stored on the device, including Google calendars you added to it.

If you linked a Google Calendar with an earlier version of the app, the data from that connection is used only to provide the features you see in LucentMeet. It is not sold, not used for advertising and not used to train generalised AI models, and any access tokens are encrypted. You can disconnect the account in Settings, or revoke access in your Google Account at any time.
LucentMeet's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

sections.title: The AI assistant
paragraphs: When you use the assistant, your message and the calendar details it needs (for example events in the time range you asked about) are sent through our server to Google's Gemini API to produce a reply. Our server does not store conversations and does not log their content. The assistant can only propose creating, changing or deleting an event; nothing changes until you confirm. Do not enter information you do not want processed this way.

sections.title: Who we share data with
paragraphs: We do not sell or rent your data and we do not share it for advertising. We use a small number of service providers who process data on our behalf:
bullets: Supabase: hosting, database and authentication for your account and synced calendars.
Google: Sign in with Google and the Gemini API for the assistant.
We may disclose information if the law requires it.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Data is sent over TLS. Calendar and account data is protected by row-level security so you can only read your own rows. Access tokens and iCal feed links are encrypted with AES-256-GCM on the server and are not readable by the app. No system is perfectly secure, but we work to protect your data.

sections.title: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: We keep your data while your account exists. Disconnecting a calendar account removes its events from LucentMeet. Delete account in Settings permanently erases your profile, synced calendars, events, reminders and stored tokens, and revokes access where applicable. Signing out clears the offline copy on your device.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR or the CCPA) you may have the right to access, correct, export or delete your data, to object to or restrict processing and to withdraw consent. Most of this you can do in the app; for anything else, contact us and we will respond within a reasonable time.

sections.title: Permissions the app may ask for
bullets: Calendars: to read (and, when you create or edit an event, write) the calendars on your device.
Notifications: to remind you before events start.
Sign in with Google / Apple: to identify your account.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: LucentMeet is not directed to children under 13 (or under 16 in the European Economic Area) and we do not knowingly collect their data. If you believe a child has given us data, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy. When we make material changes we will update the date above and, where appropriate, tell you in the app.

meet-delete-account.title: Delete your LucentMeet account
meet-delete-account.intro: You can permanently delete your LucentMeet account and all of its data at any time. Choose whichever option suits you below. Deletion is immediate and cannot be undone.

app.title: Option 1: In the app
steps: Open LucentMeet on your iPhone, iPad or Android device and sign in.
Scroll to the Privacy section and tap Delete account.
Confirm with Delete everything. Your account is deleted straight away and you are signed out.

web.title: Option 2: On the web
web.signedOut: If you signed in to LucentMeet with Google, sign in here with the same Google account to delete your account from your browser.
web.unavailable: Web deletion is temporarily unavailable. Please use the app or email us.
web.confirmBody: All synced events, preferences and stored access tokens will be permanently erased and access will be revoked at Google. This cannot be undone.
web.error: We couldn't delete your account. Please try again or email us.
web.success: Your LucentMeet account and all of its data have been deleted. You have been signed out.

email.title: Option 3: By email
email.body: Signed in with Apple, or no longer have access to the app? Email us from the address linked to your LucentMeet account and ask us to delete it. We will confirm and delete your account and data within 7 days.
email.subject: LucentMeet account deletion request

data.title: What gets deleted
deleted: Your profile (name, email address and avatar).
Connected calendar accounts and their encrypted access tokens; access is also revoked at Google.
Synced calendars, events, reminders and detected conflicts.
data.retention: Everything above is erased from our servers as soon as the deletion completes. We do not keep any of it afterwards, except where the law requires us to. The offline copy on your device is cleared when you are signed out, or when you uninstall the app.
